waiting: Waiting for the server and connection verification. You can keep editing and saving this desk.
blocked: Automatic reconnection stopped because the peer could not be verified. Save the desk or reconnect manually from the connection panel.
oldTransfer: Restart MCP to enable chunked transfer. The desk contents are kept.
released: The AI connection was released and automatic reconnection stopped. You can keep editing and saving. Use the connection panel to reconnect manually.
fileDisconnected: Connection lost. The save outcome may be unknown; it will not be retried automatically.
fileUnsupported: Normal Save/Load requires a compatible MCP connection. You can download the unsaved desk.
fileTimeout: The file operation timed out. Check the outcome before continuing; no automatic retry.
invalidUrl: Check the connection URL. Paste an HTTP URL for localhost or a LAN address authorized through AI.
portMismatch: The connection URL port numbers do not match. Check the URL.
invalidToken: The connection URL token is invalid. Check the URL.
